description: Get a best-price token swap quote on one EVM chain (KyberSwap aggregator) or a cross-chain bridge quote (LI.FI, fallback Relay; set toChain). Returns expected and minimum output, price impact, gas, every fee, safety warnings and, if you pass taker, an UNSIGNED transaction (plus exact-amount ERC-20 approval) for your own wallet to sign. Quotes are free and unlimited. Fee disclosure: same-chain swaps include a 0.25% MoneyTools fee taken from the input on-chain only if you execute; cross-chain currently 0% MoneyTools fee. Never signs, holds funds or asks for keys.

amount.description: amount to sell in human units, e.g. "10"

amountBaseUnits.description: amount in base units (integer); required for custom token addresses

chain.description: source chain: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche (or chain id)

fromToken.description: token to sell: symbol (USDC, ETH, WETH, USDT, DAI...) or 0x address

taker.description: your 0x wallet address; needed for an unsigned transaction, omit for price only

toChain.description: destination chain for a bridge; omit for a same-chain swap

toToken.description: token to buy: symbol or 0x address

name: swap_quote
title: Token swap / bridge quote (non-custodial)
